class WrongReturn {
  get value() { return 1; }
  set value(_arg: string) {}
}
const invalidObject = {
  get value() { return 1; },
  set value(_arg: string) {},
};
class Restricted {
  get value() { return 1; }
  private set value(_arg: number) {}
}
new Restricted().value = 2;
class Reversed {
  protected get value() { return 1; }
  set value(_arg: number) {}
}
class Missing {
  get value() {}
  set value(_arg: number) { return 1; }
}
class InvalidParameter {
  set optional(_arg?: number) {}
  set defaulted(_arg = 1) {}
  set rest(..._args: number[]) {}
  set annotated(_arg: number): void {}
}
interface MissingBodies {
  set optional(arg?: number);
  get unexpected(arg: number): string;
}
const defaults = { color: 'blue' };
const options = {
  color: 'red',
  ...defaults,
};
class Uninitialized {
  value;
  constructor() {
    while (false) { this.value = 1; }
  }
}
class EmptyFor {
  value;
  constructor() {
    for (; false;) { this.value = 1; }
  }
}
